Less vertical space and denser desktop card grids improve completion without removing content

experiments.decision: No observed gain; retain concrete authorized date for clarity, not claimed as conversion improvement

experiments.hypothesis: Program cards should respond to clicks on the whole card as well as their summary
experiments.decision: No observed gain; revert whole-card click handler

experiments.hypothesis: Keep registration CTA available while reading, hide it when form section is visible
experiments.decision: Revert persistent CTA; no observed gain

experiments.decision: Discard exclusive accordion; restore visible program

experiments.decision: No observed conversion gain; retain brief visible program for next controlled comparison

experiments.hypothesis: Remove pointer cursor and hover lift from informational cards that do not perform an action
